operating_notes.text: Material subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries received a ₹71.25 Cr order for solar PV modules to be executed by May 2026.
Saatvik Green Energy acquired 80% equity stake in Melcon Transformers and Electricals Private Limited for ₹2.4 Cr.
FY26 depreciation was higher by INR 96.28 million after a useful-life reassessment of plant and machinery.
A ₹39.46 million impairment was recognised on the Monoperc cash-generating unit.
Inventory valuation changed from FIFO to moving weighted average cost from March 31, 2026, restating prior periods.
Solar cell manufacturing capacity roadmap scaled to 6 GW with Phase 1 commercial production expected in H2 FY27.
Received ₹171.45 Cr solar PV module supply order from a domestic IPP/EPC player, for execution by October 2026.
Saatvik operates a 4.86 GW module plant in Ambala, Haryana, and is developing a greenfield Odisha facility with 4 GW module and 6 GW solar cell capacity.
New TOPCon 3.0 module reaches up to 670 Wp (745 W bifacial) at 24.8% efficiency with a 30-year linear warranty backed by Munich RE.

timeline.summary: Saatvik Green's subsidiary Saatvik Solar Industries secured a ₹71.25 Cr order for solar PV modules to be executed by May 2026.
Saatvik Green Energy entered into an agreement to acquire an 80% stake in Melcon Transformers for ₹2.4 Cr.
On April 23, 2026, Saatvik Green Energy reported an inadvertent contra trade violation under PIT Regulations by a relative of a designated person, resulting in a warning letter.
On May 13, 2026, Saatvik Green Energy filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, showing ₹393.19 Cr utilized out of ₹700 Cr IPO proceeds.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,607.66 Cr, net profit ₹60.42 Cr.
Saatvik Green Energy Limited shared the audio recording of its earnings call on May 21, 2026, at 11:00 AM (IST) for Q4FY26 results via its website.
Saatvik Green Energy hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting FY26 revenue of ₹4,548 Cr and expanding its solar cell capacity target to 6 GW.
Saatvik Green Energy received a ₹171.45 Cr domestic order for supply of solar PV modules to be executed by October 2026.
On 22 October 2026, Saatvik Green Energy launched its Quad-Cut TOPCon 3.0 dual-glass bifacial module (up to 670 Wp, 24.8% efficiency) at REI Expo 2026.
